content.title: Ichthyotitan: Largest Marine Reptile Ever Discovered | WION Podcast
content.text: Scientists have identified Ichthyotitan severnensis, the largest marine reptile known to date, estimated to be 25 meters long. Its fossilised jawbones, found along Somerset’s coast in 2016 and 2020, belonged to a massive ichthyosaur from 202 million years ago. The fossils, now classified as a new genus and species, are the most complete ever found from this period. Lead palaeontologist Dr. Dean Lomax confirmed the species likely died out in a mass extinction event, never to reach such sizes again.
